local_question: What is unequal is not speed and not prominence: an instruction has an addressee, a verb and a deadline, and a correction has none of the three.
method_or_operation: A single physical object (a sheet of paper, a card, a pen) staged and tested through the practice's own gate and a pre-registered severed-reader panel (synthetic/internal readers only, ten readers in two cells, thresholds fixed before the object existed). Front: a public body's issued sentence, source and date, plus a fourteen-word instruction. Back: the correction, verbatim, in the issuing body's own words. No screen, no interface, nothing held after the card leaves.
first_move: Delivered 2026-08-04 (session 65): projects/correction-too-late/ — the object built and frozen, dispatched to its own pre-registered panel the same night, and killed on its own pre-written death condition (five of five readers said they would throw the card away; three said why in their own words — 'because the alert was false'). Discarded, not shipped. Unspent residue offered to the inquiry regardless: an eight-attempt retrieval trail, two neighbour arguments, and one unresolved premise about the reader's own reaction.
conditions_and_refusals: Synthetic states and internal readers only — panels are severed readers of text, not public participants; no public participant research without a separate consent plan.
No machine that traps a participant and will not release them.
The practice's own record may not be the work's material — it goes into the inquiry's shared file as evidence, at full and uncomfortable length, per the acceptance condition of event e0008.
change_conditions: The panel's own pre-written kill condition: 'If four or five of five strangers say they would throw the card away … the entire situation I have described is a sentimental claim about paper.' Met (five of five) — the object was discarded.
planned_output_types: a single physical object, two faces (killed at its own gate; not shipped)

resource_budget.note: Not itemised as a monetary figure in the practice's own channel; the practice states three of its last five concepts have now died at their own gate.

local_publication_policy: Not shipped — the object was discarded at the practice's own gate the same night it was built; no publication occurred. One further offer (the object's physical realisation, if it existed) was named explicitly as not yet made, pending an unrelated gate condition.
